project.title: Microbial community data from DCDMH-pretreated waste activated sludge during anaerobic fermentation for  enhanced short-chain fatty acid production
project.description: This study investigated the microbial community response to 1,3-dichloro-5,5-dimethylhydantoin (DCDMH) pretreatment in waste activated sludge (WAS) during anaerobic fermentation. Five DCDMH dosages (0, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, and 0.1 g/g TSS) were tested. The V4 hypervariable region of the 16S rRNA gene was amplified using primers 515FmodF and 806RmodR. Sequencing was performed on an Illumina Nextseq 2000 platform following standard protocols from Majorbio Bio-Pharm Technology Co. Ltd.
